recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, minimalist composition featuring wispy, ethereal blue smoke trails at the top, mirrored perfectly across a central horizontal axis. The center contains two blocks of lowercase geometric text that also feature a vertical reflection effect, set against a deep black void.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between top and bottom smoke patterns
Horizontal balance between left and right text blocks
Contrast between organic fluid smoke and rigid geometric typography
Deep value contrast between vibrant blue highlights and absolute black background
coreInvariants: Electric blue to cyan color gradient in the smoke

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Smoke occupies the top and bottom thirds; text is positioned on the central horizontal meridian.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal line where the text sits and the reflection begins.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top smoke, follow the curves down to the central text, and then see the mirrored reflection below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space in the center-left and center-right areas creates a sense of depth and mystery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue and cyan highlights in the smoke trails.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White or light grey for the primary text layer.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; smoke has varying opacity and saturation levels to create a 3D effect.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is a simplified, stylized loop matching the stroke weight of the letters.

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to margins

composition.position: Centered vertically, split to left and right edges

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or single-family geometric usage to maintain minimalism.
graphicDevices: Gradient fading on the reflected text

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and clean monolinear strokes.
Classic geometric construction with sharp points.
Wide circular counters and clean lowercase appearance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast image on a pure black background. In the top third, feature wispy, flowing trails of electric blue smoke or vapor. Mirror this smoke perfectly across the horizontal center line so the bottom third is a reflection of the top. Leave the middle third mostly empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two blocks of lowercase geometric sans-serif text on the horizontal center line, one on the far left and one on the far right. Apply a vertical flip reflection to the text directly underneath, fading the reflection's opacity to zero as it moves downward.

verificationChecks: Is the smoke perfectly symmetrical across the horizontal axis?
Is the text strictly lowercase and geometric?
Is the background pure black without noise?
Does the text reflection align perfectly with the base of the letters?

adjustableVariables: Smoke color (e.g., purple, green, or white)

mustAchieve: High-definition fluid dynamics in the smoke

postGenerationChecks: Check for banding in the smoke gradients
Ensure text is legible despite the reflection
Verify the reflection axis is exactly centered
Confirm no artifacts in the black negative space
recipe.reuseFormula: Pure black canvas + mirrored fluid vapor (top/bottom) + split geometric lowercase text (center) + vertical text reflection.
